OnCorp president Joao Mattos, quoted in movimentoeconomico.com.br (14 Jan 2026): the Suape Regas terminal 'vai comecar a operar em outubro de 2027, podendo ser antecipado se a conversao do navio for mais rapida' (will begin operating in October 2027, possibly earlier if vessel conversion goes faster) -- a further slip from GEM's current LatestPlannedStartYear=2026 (itself already slipped once from OriginalPlannedStartYear=2025). Root cause per the same article: a previously-unknown sulfuric-acid pipeline from the Abreu e Lima refinery (Rnest) crossing the Regas site delayed engineering until a coexistence agreement was reached in March 2025; Antaq opened and then closed (8 Jan 2026, 'sem irregularidades') a regulatory inspection into the delay. Corroboration is thinner than the SOP's normal bar: extensive search (WebSearch budget exhausted this session; DuckDuckGo-via-curl and Wayback fallback used instead) found no independent (different-publisher) source stating the specific 2027 year -- EIA's older brief still says 'early 2026' (now superseded) and other outlets found were unreachable (Cloudflare) or didn't give a year. Staged as a single-publisher YELLOW rather than left in a qa note, per the CLAUDE.md/SOP never-punt-a-planned-start-slip rule -- this is a direct, dated, on-record executive quote, not a rumor. Flag for a follow-up batch to find a second independent source.
